definitions.explanation: A place serving simple, affordable meals, often found in schools, offices, or as small eateries.
A room in a house or building used for eating meals.

notes:
{食堂|しょくどう} has two senses: a cafeteria/eatery (sense 1) and a dining room in a home (sense 2). The word combines {食|しょく} (eat) + {堂|どう} (hall).

COMMON COMPOUNDS (sense 1):
- ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧{食堂|しょくどう}: student cafeteria (often shortened to ⟦{学食|がくしょく}→学食：12241_gakushoku⟧)
- ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧{食堂|しょくどう}: company cafeteria (⟦{社食|しゃしょく}→社食：27579_shashoku⟧)
- ⟦{大衆|たいしゅう}→大衆：10150_taishuu⟧{食堂|しょくどう}: casual working-class eatery

SENSE DISTINCTION:
- As 'cafeteria/eatery': emphasizes affordable, simple meals in an institutional or no-frills setting
- As 'dining room': the room in a house where meals are eaten (more formal than ⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧ which is the kitchen)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧: restaurant (more upscale)
- {食堂|しょくどう}: cafeteria or casual eatery (simpler, cheaper)
